course_description: Focuses on the fundamental networking concepts and technologies. Cisco Certified Networking Associate (CCNA) course incorporates theoretical aspects and practical application while providing students the skills and hands-on experience needed to design, install, operate and maintain networks. The course covers a complete range of networking concepts, and features many hands-on projects where students have access to the building blocks of Local and Wide Area Networks (LANs and WANs), such as wireless access points, switches, and routers.

course_learning_outcomes.text: Explain the concept of network communication;
create a simulated network using Packet Tracer;
explain the principles of IPv4 and IPv6 address management;
configure initial settings on a network device;
describe data communications and network models, topologies, protocols, standards and architectures; and
explain how to use security best practices to mitigate attacks.
